title: The Door That Watches
prompt: A while loop keeps running WHILE its condition is true. Predict what happens.

rounds.code:
steps = 3
while steps > 0:
    print(steps)
    steps = steps - 1
rounds.explain: The loop runs WHILE steps > 0. When steps reaches 0 the condition is false, so the loop ends — 0 never prints.
Nothing ever lowers steps, so steps > 0 stays true forever. This is the Warden's curse: a loop with no way to reach its ending.
